implemented_capabilities.capability: Versioned facts: FactVersion chain with SUPERSEDES and compare-and-set on case_version
implemented_capabilities.notes: One atomic Cypher: MATCH patient WHERE p.case_version=$case_version, SET case_version+1, keep old FactVersion (superseded_at), CREATE new FactVersion with (new)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(old), create EvidenceEvent. No returned row means stale case_version (HTTP 409). Event ids are idempotent and resumable (status pending/applying/applied).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Dependency-driven re-evaluation cascade (affected findings by cited/needed fact)
implemented_capabilities.notes: Q3 finds only Findings that CITES|FROM|TO the changed fact or NEEDS an EvidenceRequirement ABOUT it; only those are re-run through engine/rules.py; unaffected findings are untouched (tests assert that editing atorvastatin creates no revision).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Immutable finding revisions with review-decision lineage and needs_reassessment
implemented_capabilities.notes: When evidence changes under a reviewed finding a new FindingRevision n+1 is linked PREVIOUS to n and BECAUSE to the EvidenceEvent with status needs_reassessment; the clinician ReviewDecision stays on the revision it was made on. Review writes are compare-and-set on both case_version and revision_n (409 stale_revision).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Deterministic rule engine for candidate-pattern status with explicit unknown handling
implemented_capabilities.notes: Pure-Python rule precedence (not_matched > competing_explanation > needs_evidence > candidate) over Q1 rows; unknown never becomes no; one EvidenceRequirement per gap; eval_version tracked. Domain is medication prescribing cascades with one curated cited pattern (data/patterns/pat-ccb-edema-loop.json).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Bounded allowlisted review agent with deterministic fallback
implemented_capabilities.notes: LLM only picks one of six allowlisted tools and phrases text; replies are validated (allowed tool, IDs must have been seen in earlier tool results, no invented days/medicines, copy-rule check) and fall back to templates. Every tool call is persisted as an AgentStep. LLM optional (no LLM_API_KEY means templates).
FD_STORE=graph uses FalkorDB; default fixtures mode serves in-memory FixtureStore (api/store.py) mirrored by data/snapshots/fixtures.json for the web demo.

graph_models_and_cypher: One FalkorDB graph per family (family_<id>) plus kb_template. Nodes (from the .cypher files): Patient{case_version}, MedicationEpisode, Observation, Ingredient, DrugClass, Effect, Pattern, Source, Finding{status,revision_n,eval_version}, FindingRevision{n}, ReviewDecision, EvidenceEvent{status,case_version,change,before,after}, EvidenceRequirement, FactVersion{n,superseded_at,event_id}, Question, AgentStep. Edges: HAS, OF, IN_CLASS, INDEX, MARKER, VIA, OF_EFFECT, FROM, TO, MATCHES, CITES, NEEDS, ABOUT, VERSION, SUPERSEDES, PREVIOUS, BECAUSE, RECORDED, ON. All Cypher lives in named, parameterized .cypher files loaded via engine.cypher.load(); contracts test enforces every traversal starts at Patient {id:$pid}. FalkorDB 4.22-compatible (uses [:A|B|C], UNION, collect over OPTIONAL MATCH); no APOC/GDS; graph.copy() used for family fork with MERGE-load fallback.
algorithms: Affected-subgraph computation: Q3 = UNION of (Finding)-[:CITES|FROM|TO]->(fact) and (Finding)-[:NEEDS]->(:EvidenceRequirement)-[:ABOUT]->(fact) (engine/queries/q3_affected.cypher)
Optimistic concurrency: compare-and-set case_version/revision_n in a single write query (write/evidence_apply.cypher, write/review.cypher)
Idempotent resumable event application: pending -> applying -> applied with stored before/after/findings_before (api/graph_store.py:320-423)
Rule precedence status engine over temporal ordering (index start < effect onset < marker start) with unknown-as-gap semantics (engine/rules.py)
Sliding-window per-IP rate limiter for LLM passes (api/main.py:RateLimit)
backend_interfaces: mcp/ directory is only a .gitkeep (reserved, not implemented)
frontend_interfaces: Next.js app router: app/page.tsx, app/patients/[pid], app/packet/[id], app/states; components: workspace, medication-river (timeline), investigation-drawer, change-card (before/after diff), state-notice, dominoes, next-question, agent-panel, packet, sandbox-panel, fact-states, source-list
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Persistent AgentStep log per tool call; FindingRevision/ReviewDecision lineage; EvidenceEvent journal with replay; bounded one-pass review agent with allowlist and ID-grounding validator; LLM (OpenAI-compatible, default Groq) optional with model fallback; no free-form long-term memory.
tests_present: tests/: ~112 test functions across test_agent.py (23), test_graph.py (29, requires a real FalkorDB), test_rules.py (16, pure-Python), test_api.py (15), test_deploy.py (11), test_golden.py (8), test_contracts.py (5, includes copy-rule scan and first-MATCH enforcement), test_stack.py (5, docker restart durability). Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: agent/llm.py:80-91 - outbound urllib POST to LLM_BASE_URL (default api.groq.com); base URL is env-controlled, so SSRF only via deployer config. Key sent in Authorization header, never logged (good).
api/main.py:215 - POST /sandbox/reset is unauthenticated and drops and reseeds the family graph (destructive); no authn/authz anywhere in the API (patient scoping is by id only).
api/main.py:187-196 - client_ip trusts X-Real-IP / X-Forwarded-For so the rate limit is spoofable outside Railway.
docker-compose.yml - FalkorDB port exposed with no password by default; FalkorDB Browser exposed on 3000.
No eval/exec/pickle/subprocess found; all Cypher is parameterized named files (no string-built Cypher); no hard-coded secrets (tests/test_deploy.py:18 uses a dummy value asserted never to leak).
duplicates_or_overlaps: Core mechanics overlap evidence provenance/supersession/decision lineage (the Evidence Drift Cascade family). Domain (medication prescribing cascades, synthetic patients) is not a Kairos industrial domain, so only the engine pattern is reusable, not the clinical rules.
evidence_drift_relevance: HIGH - Implements fact versioning with SUPERSEDES, dependency-targeted re-evaluation (Q3), immutable FindingRevision lineage with BECAUSE->EvidenceEvent, needs_reassessment gating that preserves prior human ReviewDecision, idempotent evidence events and optimistic-concurrency 409s: nearly a reference implementation of an Evidence Drift Cascade.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Domain-neutral supersession + cascade pattern in FalkorDB-native Cypher with atomic compare-and-set; swap Patient for Case/Claim and MedicationEpisode/Observation for Evidence to get an Evidence Drift engine. Rules (engine/rules.py) are domain-specific and should be replaced by Kairos validity rules.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB (falkordb>=1.0 client; server 4.x features used); no LLM required (optional OpenAI-compatible key for the agent)

strategy_rationale: Extract the versioned-fact / affected-set / revision / decision-lineage Cypher and the compare-and-set + idempotent-event logic as a domain-neutral Evidence Drift engine inside Kairos; keep the medication rules and UI as reference only. Same stack (FastAPI + FalkorDB client), so little porting friction.
